description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the Search service within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods to retrieve various configuration sections such as delete, deletion, update, and stream configurations, and also defines an enum for specific default config values.

classes.name: SearchConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration accessors for the Search service, extending multiple configuration interfaces, and including an enum for default config values.

classes.name: SearchConfig.SearchConfigValue
classes.description: An enum listing known configuration path expressions and their default values, specifically for 'mongo-hints-by-namespace'.

methods.name: getMongoHintsByNamespace
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the MongoDB hints namespace string if configured.

methods.name: getDeleteConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration settings related to delete operations.

methods.name: getDeletionConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration settings for physically deleting marked entities.

methods.name: getUpdaterConfig
methods.description: Provides the configuration for search updating operations.

methods.name: getStreamConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for stream-related functionalities.
